job.jdText: About Radiant Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the worldâs first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The companyâs first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiantâs unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028. About the Role Radiant is seeking a driven recent grad to join our talent team and help build the engineering teams behind Kaleidos, our portable, mass-producible nuclear microreactor targeting commercial deployment in 2028. This is a role for someone who wants to start a career in recruitment, work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with real ownership and influence, build a deep tech career, and learn about several technical domains like nuclear, hardware, electrical, software, and more. You'll get close mentorship from recruiters and sourcers who've built teams before, regular visibility with executives, own requisitions, and find top talent for engineering leaders and their teams. Responsibilities and Duties Run your own reqs from open to close, building the pipeline, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and getting offers signed. Find niche talent markets for specialized engineering roles in places like GitHub repos, arXiv papers, technical mailing lists, tech foundation communities, conference speaker rosters, and academic programs. Create talent market reports based on research you drive to help make better-informed recruiting strategies. Coordinate interviews and help facilitate hiring team debriefs to keep decisions moving quickly. Sit in on offer conversations with senior recruiters and learn how strategy and closing work in practice. Help shape how Radiant recruits; the processes, tools, and 3rd party platforms you help build and adopt now become the foundation the team scales on. Get hands-on exposure to hiring across multiple technical functions: electrical, mechanical, software, and more. Required Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor's degree from an accredited university. 0â2 years of experience in recruiting, sales, sourcing, or coordination, or you've picked it up on your own and can point to something that proves it. Something outside the classroom that shows real team influence, a club you led, student government, a project you built, a sport you competed in, or work you volunteered for. A genuine pull toward hardware, nuclear, physics, or AI/ML; you don't need an engineering background, just real curiosity. A bias toward action: you move quickly, problem-solve on the fly, and know when to raise your hand for help. You're able to hold a genuine conversation with technical candidates, curious enough to ask good questions, and honest enough to admit when something's outside your depth. Desired Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor's degree in a STEM-related major is a plus. Any prior exposure to hardware, software, engineering, or tech recruiting, even informally. Comfort picking up new tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, sourcing, LLM platforms, even without direct prior experience. Additional Requirements: Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission. Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ. One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents. Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents. Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents. Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits. 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees. Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks. Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation. Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie. Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean. Total Compensation and Benefits Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiantâs new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant. job.title: Animal Cruelty Case Specialist
job.jdText: Description Term of Employment: Full-Time, Exempt Reports To: Criminal Justice Program Managing Attorney Union: Bargaining Unit Position, Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU) Location: Remote (U.S. Based) Who We Are The Animal Legal Defense Fundâs mission is to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system. The Animal Legal Defense Fund accomplishes this mission by filing high-impact lawsuits to protect animals from harm, providing free legal assistance and training to prosecutors to assure that animal abusers are held accountable for their crimes, supporting tough animal protection legislation and fighting legislation harmful to animals, gathering data about and advocating for effective regulation of animal exploitative industries and providing resources and opportunities to law students and professionals to advance the emerging field of animal law. Role Description The Criminal Justice Program (CJP) Animal Cruelty Case Specialist position furthers the mission of the Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system, by providing prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues with essential operational and forensic support on criminal animal cruelty cases and encouraging the investigation and prosecution of animal crimes to ensure justice for animal victims. The CJP Animal Cruelty Case Specialist triages all incoming reports of animal cruelty and maintains the active case database. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist applies their experience and expertise to in-depth case-related research and to the training of key stakeholders. This position acts as a liaison across ALDFâs programs to disseminate approved case response information in a timely and responsible manner. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist is accountable for the day-to-day management of their assigned cases and projects. How You Will Make a Difference Case Support Receive reports of animal cruelty and requests for case assistance from professional stakeholders, the Administrative Manager, and other sources. Provide initial responses and triage via phone or email. Exercise discretion in analyzing and recommending which cases CJP chooses to pursue, including communicating efficiently with complainants and advocates by phone and email; gathering relevant facts (through eyewitness accounts, media reports, and other sources as needed) for potential criminal cruelty cases; and identifying, after thorough independent analysis, those cases warranting further investigation and/or veterinary forensics. Generate and categorize cases, and work with Managing Attorneys to assign cases to CJP staff according to department protocols. Ensure that complete and accurate case information is relayed in a timely fashion to the appropriate team members. Input and access information using automated systems, make entries into automated record files, seek to maximize use of automated systems available to CJP to further efficiency and accuracy in case response and record keeping. Maintain and organize all case-related records and documentation in a timely, logical, and confidential manner. Ensure that electronic logs of all legal cases are accurate and current. Review case notes to maintain consistent and timely response in all cases. Conduct internet research on potential/active cases (i.e. Facebook, social media, news sources, and company websites). Provide basic assistance in research projects, special reports, and case information gathering. Prepare materials for meetings, court proceedings, and case discovery. Follow up with professional stakeholders on case outcomes/resolutions where possible. Create and maintain a system for tracking date and time of upcoming court proceedings related to CJP-assisted cases. Manage CJP grant processing for expert witnesses, forensic testing, and costs of care in criminal cases, coordinating with internal and external individuals as needed. Inform and assist law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues on animal cruelty case investigations and case strategies, including reviewing and advising on interview tactics, department policies and procedures, veterinary exams and reports, protective custody foster care programs and related agreements, and large-scale animal rescue implementation. Participate in deployment to crime scenes and rescues as needed, exercising discretion in both the decision to travel on-site and the orchestration of such activities. Assist with hands-on scene processing for animal cruelty cases, including identifying, collecting and packaging evidence; assisting with logistics and operational expertise; and assisting with other aspects of search and seizure operations and animal rescue support. Provide support as requested to CJP Case Response Unit. External Relationship Building and Outreach Build strategic relationships with prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues to facilitate agency assistance in forensics, crime scene processing, and veterinary medicine. Schedule and conduct outreach and training presentations for various disciplines, including but not limited to law enforcement agencies, veterinarians, prosecutors, animal shelters and rescues, and social service agencies. Internal Relationship Building Proactively maintain intradepartmental relationships and act as a liaison to other programs. Create and maintain system for sharing information about CJP case work and outcomes across departments and facilitate the sharing of information approved for public-facing materials. Provide in-house expertise for staff on questions concerning Criminal Justice Program cases, animal cruelty cases in general, criminal investigation, veterinary forensics, animal rescue and sheltering. Please note, this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position, which are subject to change in order to best advance ALDFâs strategic objectives and mission. Requirements We Are Looking for Candidates With: A bachelorâs degree in a related field desired; or 5 years equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of. At least 3 years of experience in enforcement fieldwork operations, animal cruelty response, dispatch, and/or criminal case management. Demonstrated veterinary forensics or animal cruelty enforcement expertise, including but not limited to, retaining related certifications in the field (such as Certificate in Veterinary Forensics, NACA certifications, FEMA certification, Property and Evidence Certifications, Police or Humane Officer certification). The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and materials according to the highest standards of confidentiality, chain of custody, and ethical conduct and exercise discretion in the use of related materials and information. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, organizational members and supporters, members of the public, and others. A positive attitude, ability to work cooperatively with others, and ability to function well in a team-oriented work environment. Comfort speaking in public to audiences of various sizes and demographics. The ability to maintain composure and lead others in times of heightened urgency or stress. An understanding of and full commitment to the vision, mission, and core values of the Animal Legal Defense Fund. The ability to travel frequently to conferences, trainings, meetings, and other events as required; estimated 5-7 events per year. We Offer Competitive Compensation With Excellent Benefits, Including Starting annual salary of $71,509 for most geographic locations. For candidates located within 25 miles of Washington D.C., Cotati, CA, and Los Angeles, starting pay is $75,273. For candidates located within 25 miles of New York City and San Francisco, starting pay is $79,036. To ensure salary equity, we do not negotiate salary outside of the published starting rate. job.title: Enterprise Account Executive
job.jdText: About Haven Safety: Haven is transforming how organizations learn from workplace incidents. Built in partnership with The AES Corporation and backed by AI Fund, Haven applies purpose-built AI to incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and organizational learning. Our platform helps utilities, energy companies, construction firms, and other high-risk industries dramatically reduce investigation effort while improving investigation quality and organizational learning. We're an early-stage company with enterprise customers, global ambitions, and an experienced leadership team. We're looking for exceptional salespeople who enjoy building a category rather than simply selling software. The Opportunity: We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive with a successful track record selling enterprise EHS software. You will own opportunities from discovery through executive alignment, proof of value, commercial negotiation, and close. You will engage Fortune 1000 executives across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement and help customers rethink how work gets done through AI. \n Responsibilities Include: Own enterprise sales opportunities from qualification through close. Develop executive relationships across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement. Lead consultative discovery and business value discussions. Demonstrate Haven's platform and ROI. Coordinate pilots and proof-of-value engagements. Build business cases and ROI models. Navigate enterprise procurement, security, and legal reviews. Partner with Customer Success during implementation. Represent Haven at industry events. Consistently exceed revenue targets. What Success Looks Like: Within your first year you will close multiple enterprise customers, become a trusted advisor to senior EHS leaders, contribute to Haven's go-to-market strategy, and help establish Haven as the leader in AI-powered industrial safety. Required Experience Includes: 7+ years of enterprise B2B software sales. Success selling into Fortune 1000 organizations. Experience leading complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles. Consistent history of exceeding quota. Experience building executive relationships with EHS, Operations, Risk, or Operational Excellence leaders. Strong consultative selling skills. Excellent executive communication and presentation skills. Experience navigating procurement, security, and legal reviews. Nice to Haves Include: AI or advanced analytics solutions. Utilities, Oil & Gas, Construction, Manufacturing, Mining, Chemicals, or other high-risk industries. Early-stage or venture-backed SaaS companies. Experience with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Challenger. Direct experience selling EHS (Environmental, Health & Safety) software solutions. \n Why Join Haven: Build a new AI category, work directly with founders and enterprise customers, influence product direction, receive competitive compensation, uncapped commissions, equity participation, health benefits, and flexible working arrangements.
